answers.text: "A break above value is not Elder's entry": true for Elder, not for a base-reader. My test: W HH/HL, 1.9% under the 20-wk high; D close 37.74 sits 15.0% over the last swing high, so the LH/LL label is stale; day_vol 1.66 clears 1.40. Extension is a weight, not a reject. Not conceded.

"LH/LL label stale: close 6.24% over last swing high": the price through the swing high is real, but my test is L, not the swing label. rs_leadership LAGGARD (downday -0.8) and lens leadership warn stand on W, D and H1 alike; day_vol 4.46 does not make a laggard a leader (C9, C10). Not conceded.

"Group rank 1-3 is not my test": it is mine. C9 buys only the number 1, 2 or 3 name; beating the index (rs_spy_20d 9.57) is a lower bar than leading the group. rs_leadership LAGGARD, rs_rank_pct 81.01 barely over the 80 gate. W/D/H1 trend is intact, but that is not L. Not conceded.
